description: Get the rank-change alert configuration for one RankParse website: whether weekly alert digests are enabled (they are opt-in and default off), the moved_up/moved_down position threshold, and the optional digest email override. Delivery is Sunday at 18:00 UTC when meaningful changes exist.

site_id.description: Logical RankParse website ID, from list_rank_tracking_sites

name: get_rank_alert_settings
